formulas.ascii: Coarser levels ell >= 1: counts[ell,p] = sum(c in C[ell,p]) counts[ell-1,c] modulo 2^32; sums[ell,p] = sum(c in C[ell,p]) sums[ell-1,c] modulo 2^64. C[ell,p] groups finer rows by the parent key at resolutions[ell]. Level 0 uses GPUCellAggregation: count accepted rows and sum saturated roundHalfEven(f32(value * sumScale)). Intermediate sums/extremes are retained when coarser levels need them. Conservation compares individual level totals, with no filtering or capacity losses between them; levelCounts counts occupied cells, not input events.
